scope: Source integration review of audit repairs with customer-auth navigation, plus the retention WAL-checkpoint fixture delta. Not a deployment acceptance.

findings.audit_fixes_preserved: Direct diff against 06f3 confirmed the A04 admin code, A05 stores UI/backend and A03/A06 production runtime code are unchanged.
findings.stores_interaction: The stores recovery scope remains tied to the verified profile tenant/customer; pending UUID, Web Lock and command-status recovery are unchanged.
findings.auth_navigation: Cabinet navigation and login/start reuse require a backend-validated product session. Origin, query and consent validation precede POST reuse; unavailable profile lookup fails closed.
findings.auth_cache: React cache is scoped to a server render/request; this is not a process-wide authorization cache. Route handlers do not share a persistent session cache.
findings.identity_delta: Customer reentry heading and stale SUCCESS-flash filtering only; native fresh challenge, logout POST and CSRF remain.
findings.protected_protocols: Customer and staff protocol implementations are unchanged against 06f3.
findings.retention_delta: The fixture commits DROP and requires a successful WAL checkpoint before measuring the main database file. The compaction assertions are preserved.
findings.whitespace_check: git diff --check for the reviewed product/identity/retention source scope passed.

limitations: This is source review, not a full authentication or penetration audit.
The reviewer did not personally run the full CI or the reported 58 retention checks.
The integration candidate was not installed or activated by this reviewer; the earlier installed smoke verdict remains attached to 06f3.
No real accounts, MFA factors, credentials, live configuration values or provider APIs were inspected or changed.
Additional historical documentation and operational receipts in the merge were not treated as new live acceptance.
